messages:
maria: Thinking out loud — we need a richer synthetic traffic generator for kernel/batching perf work. Current ramps are too smooth; they miss burst-induced cache thrash and tail latency spikes. goal: reproducible bursts + long-tail token sizes + cold vs warmed KV cache. ideas? :thinking_face:

derek: +1. We should support at least three arrival models: fixed qps, Poisson, and bursty ON/OFF (Pareto for ON durations). also a separate distribution for prompt lengths (bimodal: short 8-64 and long 512-2048).

alex: Important: apples-to-apples comparison requires locking down model version, quantization, kernel flags, and disabling autoscale. otherwise noisy. We should make a test checklist that sets: MODEL_SHA, KERNEL_OVERRIDES, BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS, CACHE_WARM=false/true.

maria: Agreed. Also want a mode to replay sampled production traces (anonymized) so we can validate synth vs real. replay harness should force same arrivals and payloads but run multiple kernel configs back-to-back.

jen: Small nit: make sure generator can toggle KV cache behavior per request: i.e., send a mix of cache-warm requests (with KV prefill) and cache-cold (new prefixes) at configurable ratios. I saw a 2.3x cost and big p99 uplift when cache hit rate dropped during bursts.

perf-bot: perf-check: recent benchmark vs cuBLASLt change shows p95 increased by 22% under bursty ON/OFF with batch_timeout_ms=20ms. linking profile: https://perf.internal/reports/2026/177500. (automated) :robot_face:

simon: Oof. That suggests queuing + kernel selection path triggers slower kernel for short sequences. We should add a kernel-override stress test: force older kernel vs new one with same sequence distribution and compare token throughput and p99.

ops-tester: For reproducibility, we also need: pinned hardware (same GPU model + driver), CPU affinity pinned for serving threads, and minimal background load. otherwise small baseline diffs blow up in tail.

derek: Proposed generator config snippet (yaml):
```
generator:
  arrival_model: on_off_pareto
  on_shape: 1.5
  on_scale_ms: 2000
  off_mean_ms: 3000
  base_qps: 50
  burst_multiplier: 8
  poisson_lambda: null

payload:
  prompt_length_dist: bimodal
  short: {prob: 0.7, range: [8, 64]}
  long: {prob: 0.3, range: [512, 1024]}
  tokenization: gpt-tokenizer-v2
  cache_warm_ratio: 0.6

replay:
  enabled: false
  sample_rate: 0.01
```

alex: Nice. Also add two more toggles: inter-request jitter (percent) to avoid perfect periodic bursts, and a seed field for deterministic runs.

jen: For analytics we need per-request metadata in traces: arrival_model, request_index, is_cache_warm, kernel_used (from runtime logs), batch_size_at_dispatch. That lets us pivot latency by kernel/batch.

maria: Quick checklist for apples-to-apples run:
- set MODEL_SHA same across runs
- set KERNEL_FLAGS identical except the one under test
- run 20 trials of identical generator seed
- pre-warm KV cache scenario and cold-cache scenario separately
- pin infra and disable autoscale/eviction
- collect perf counters (SM utilization, memory copy stalls, CPU runnable time)

perf-bot: note: capture flamegraphs for dispatch and kernel launch path. last regression traced to lock contention inside kernel selection (fast path fell back to slower kernel under load).

simon: For the replay harness: strip sensitive fields, keep only token lengths and relative timestamps, and provide a helper to synthesize prompts matching length buckets. avoids PII and keeps distribution.

ops-tester: Can someone open the infra PR to add on_off_pareto and cache toggles to the generator? I'll run a 48h soak once it's merged.

derek: opened a draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 — includes generator change + a compare script that runs two kernel configs and emits CSV with p50/p95/p99, cost/token, and batch-size histogram. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: Next steps: derek to finalize config schema + seedable runs, jen to add trace fields to runtime logs, ops-tester to run pinned hardware experiments, simon to add replay sanitizer. We'll reconvene after first 48h soak. :eyes:

alex: one more ask — make the default burst_multiplier conservative (4) for CI so we don't blow through quotas, but allow heavier bursts (8-16) in perf lab.

maria: thanks all. documenting these in /docs/perf/synth-generator.md and will attach the checklist to the PR.

ops-tester: running an initial smoke today at 16:00 UTC — will post results here. :rocket:
